sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 – binding annual commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We propose EUR 29.89/unit, our current unit price, for 23,400 units per year over 12 months, with a 56-day lead time. We accept the longer 56-day lead time and would make the full annual quantity binding, in line with your note that firm commitments receive priority.

Our September forecast for this seal records a 10.1% change (fc:340010@2026-09). We understand from the August report that you are allocating volumes against last year's call-offs (news:20260822-23), and we respect that constraint. How could a binding annual commitment secure our increased allocation?

We look forward to your view on this package.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 – binding annual commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the news data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We acknowledge your request; however, strict allocation constraints limit our maximum volume to 19,890 units per year. We accept the proposed 56-day lead time. Based on these parameters, our revised offer is a price of €32.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 19890 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 – three-year binding commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for accepting the 56-day lead time. We understand the allocation limits you describe. We would like to give you a longer, firmer basis for allocating our full quantity.

We therefore raise our proposed price to EUR 30.70/unit and extend the commitment from one year to three. That is 23,400 units per year over 36 months, a proposed binding 70,200 units in total (23,400 x 3), with a 56-day lead time.

For context, our own bottom-up estimate for this seal is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010). This is our internal estimate, not a statement of your costs.

Would this larger three-year commitment support allocating 23,400 units per year at the proposed price?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 – three-year binding commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your internal cost estimate; while noted, our pricing reflects the specialized nature of our products. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We can accommodate the requested allocation of 23,400 units per year over a 36-month contract. Based on these parameters, our revised offer is a price of €31.60 per unit. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days.

This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.
